description: Human-calibrated picker presets for chess-sf-worker.py (elo mode). Target = Lichess Rapid/Classical rating. Between anchors the worker interpolates knobs linearly; outside it clamps to the nearest anchor. See CALIBRATION.md.

1000.method: self-play batch G52b36: 12 games, 1426 non-forced bot moves, scored by Stockfish depth 14 with tools/calibration/metrics.py (Lichess formulas)

1400.note: PROVISIONAL: extrapolated from the 1000 tuning runs (fewer blind turns, lower temperature). Not validated; targets 1100-1400 are interpolated guesses. Calibrate before trusting (see CALIBRATION.md).
